=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text s "alphaBETA"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note upper, lower and swap change ASCII letters only; strings up to 256 bytes (longer traps 3)
fn conv a view uchar * mode ulong to void
r = new uchar 256 0
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
up = and ge c 65 le c 90
lo = and ge c 97 le c 122
if and lo ne mode 1
c = sub c 32
else
if and up ne mode 0
c = add c 32
end
end
put r i c
end
emit part r 0 len a
emit nl
end
fn main to int
note mode 0 upper, 1 lower, 2 swap case
conv s 0
conv s 1
conv s 2
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
ALPHABETA
alphabeta
ALPHAbeta
</pre>
